preserved.subject: Literature in English
preserved.question_a: Antithesis is a figure of speech that presents:
preserved.answer_a: A — contrasting ideas in balanced or parallel structure
preserved.question_b: Synecdoche is a figure of speech in which:
preserved.answer_b: A — a part represents the whole, or vice versa
preserved.reason: Antithesis is based on balanced contrast; synecdoche is a part–whole relationship. They are distinct literary devices and definitions.
